title: A lifetime Windows 11 Pro license is $9.97 through Cyber Monday
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Run Windows apps on your Mac with a lifetime Windows 11 Pro license, now $9.97 (reg. $199).

Some apps and games still only run on Windows, so many Mac owners use Parallels Desktop or VMware Fusion to run them. Either one still needs a Windows license, and a full-price copy costs close to $200. From Black Friday through Cyber Monday, you can pick up a lifetime Windows 11 Pro license for $9.97 (reg. $199).

Pro comes with tools that Windows 11 Home doesn’t include. BitLocker encrypts your drive, Windows Sandbox lets you test unfamiliar apps in an isolated space, and Hyper-V runs virtual machines. You also get Snap layouts for arranging windows, and Copilot in the taskbar for quick questions or to summarize a page.

This license works with Parallels Pro, so you can run Windows apps next to your Mac apps without rebooting. Keep in mind that it’s Windows only and doesn’t include or upgrade Microsoft Office. Each license installs on a single device, and your code arrives via email right after checkout.

Stop paying full price for the Windows side of your Mac.

Grab Windows 11 Pro for $9.97 through December 13 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
